races.display_title: Betfair Backs Opinions Superior Mile Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: NEEDLE MATCH found the 2000 Guineas coming too soon in his development but he got his career firmly back on track with an eye-catching second in a Group 3 at Leopardstown last month so he shades the vote over fellow 3-y-o Hankelow , who has had valid excuses since his excellent third in the French 2000 Guineas. Decent claims can also be made for Persica and The Lost King . NEEDLE MATCH HANKELOW (IRE) PERSICA (IRE)

races.display_title: Betfair Celebrates Bow Echo Ascendant Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: ROCKET BOY cemented a really positive start to his career when a keeping-on third at this listed level at Salisbury 3 weeks ago. That sets a pretty good standard and with the prospect of more to come, he looks the answer. First Law is open to any amount of improvement, however, while Rafe's Da Man has raced 4 times but is going the right way, too. ROCKET BOY (IRE) FIRST LAW (IRE) RAFE'S DA MAN

races.display_title: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: A useful handicap that seems sure to prove strong form. GALILEAN QUALITY shaped notably well in sustaining his run from a long way back when runner-up in the Melrose at York a fortnight ago and still looks on good mark following a 5 lb rise. Asia Force , a stablemate of the selection, immediately showed the benefit of a gelding operation when a dominant winner at Carlisle and could have more to offer, with Bridge of Eagles also of interest upped markedly in trip. GALILEAN QUALITY (IRE) ASIA FORCE (IRE) BRIDGE OF EAGLES (IRE)

races.display_title: Betfair Exchange Old Borough Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: There's a feeling at least one of the unexposed sorts will come to the fore. AEGEAN PRINCE hasn't been seen since finishing second in a French listed event at the end of last October but he romped home in an Ascot novice after a similar length of absence last year and he's preferred to Finalise and Kissmehoneyhoney , whose trainer William Haggas has won this twice in recent years. Ian Williams is also no stranger to success in this contest and his Hermetic completes the shortlist. AEGEAN PRINCE FINALISE KISSMEHONEYHONEY

races.display_title: Betfair Sprint Cup Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: PABORUS impressed when beating Marvelman in the Chipchase over 6f at Newcastle on his reappearance. He was behind that same rival in the recent City of York over 7f but was still bang there entering the final furlong and can get the better of Andrew Balding's charge back sprinting. Next on the list is Almeraq , whose overall record suggests he'll bounce back from a lesser effort in the July Cup, particularly given how well he handles ease in the ground. PABORUS MARVELMAN (IRE) ALMERAQ

races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but TRILBY hasn't looked back since the cheekpieces went on and is fancied to garner a fourth victory of 2026, with conditions right in his favour at a track he goes well at. races.verdict: BRIGHTON BOY has an impressive record under these sort of conditions and he gets the vote in an open-looking handicap. The David O'Meara pair both make appeal from falling marks with Darkness preferred of the 2, while Star Anthem could prove well treated if back on song. BRIGHTON BOY (IRE) DARKNESS (FR) STAR ANTHEM (IRE)

races.verdict: STARLINER rates the pick of the weights racing off the same mark as when a very close recent C&D second, so he gets the vote over course specialist Second Fiddle , who returns to her favoured venue in good nick after a spell on the turf. Ey Up He's A Star also has winning form around here and can play a prominent role, too. STARLINER (IRE) SECOND FIDDLE (IRE) EY UP HE'S A STAR

races.display_title: William Hill September Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: GETHIN is quite a keen goer but his near miss in a French listed race last autumn shows he has the stamina for 1½m and he can bounce back from his below-par run in the Eclipse and prove too strong for Pride of Arras and Tornado Alert . Outstanding hurdler Constitution Hill showed enough in 2 all-weather wins in the spring to think he can make his presence felt in Group races on the Flat. races.verdict: TAWAKAL has made a highly-encouraging start to his career and has the scope and pedigree to go on progressing now upped in grade, so he's an appealing candidate. races.display_title: Envesca Safety Champions Handicap Chase
races.verdict: DANNY'S FRIEND resumed winning ways in impressive fashion at Newton Abbot in June and, with the extra distance potentially triggering further improvement, a 7 lb higher mark may not be enough to prevent the follow up. Jack Doyen was still going with zest when unseating his rider here recently and remains one to bear in mind now he's seemingly a reformed character, while the strong-travelling Huckleberry Sting is also respected as a last-time-out scorer. DANNY'S FRIEND (IRE) JACK DOYEN (IRE) HUCKLEBERRY STING

races.display_title: Andy Townsend Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: The addition of a first-time tongue strap could benefit BLACKWATER LILLY , who is fairly treated on her best form, so she's awarded the tentative nod. Mistral Blue can do better back in this company and may be the main danger. Parikarma and Sadies Diamond are honourable mentions. BLACKWATER LILLY MISTRAL BLUE PARIKARMA (IRE)

races.verdict: YOUR A DAISY makes plenty of appeal on debut, being a half-sister to several winners and representing a yard capable of readying one first time out. races.display_title: Christmas Parties At Navan Racecourse On 6th & 13th December Handicap
races.verdict: NAMIID won over this C&D in May and is taken to build on some solid handicap efforts and resume winning ways back at this venue. Moltophino shaped well last time and is feared most from what looks a workable mark, while the thriving Amiata is also respected. NAMIID (IRE) MOLTOPHINO (IRE) AMIATA (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Amiata (5/2), Moltophino (3/1), Namiid (7/2), Erosandpsyche (5/1), Allsortz (13/2), Gotta Catch'em All (12/1), Thunderbear (14/1), Dandyville (66/1)

races.verdict: MILLHONE has been knocking on the door and can deservedly get her head in front for the first time. Nibras Rainbow has had a productive summer and should figure again. Connova also makes the shortlist along with Morning Approach for in-form Wille McCreery. MILLHONE (IRE) NIBRAS RAINBOW (IRE) CONNOVA (IRE)
